findings.label: D9 follows the source order

findings.label: O25 "even" or "actually", 1 in my text (TELLS-FROM-PANGRAM-DATA-20261007.md: they go with the failing paragraphs; "They're words I add to sound casual, and they don't help"): keep one only where it says something
examples: This psychological trick has a rich history around it, and the blind spot behind it even has a name, Solomon’s paradox, after the biblical king everybody brough
findings.reason: The "even" is his ("and even has a name"), kept with his sentence; it says the effect is well enough known to be named.

findings.label: O6 a candidate, to judge, not a finding: a feeling or idea doing what a person does. A neat, quotable line is the tell ("Grief doesn't keep a schedule"); a phrase people say all the time is not (Joel 2026-10-07 23:50: "Modern life trains us" is "so common it's almost cliche, it's not a witty AI quip"). Judge each with abstract_agents_prompt.py or by his ratings; fix only a quip, giving the action to a person with as few words changed as possible
examples: This psychological trick has a rich history around it, and the blind spot behind it even has a name, Solomon’s paradox, after the biblical king everybody brough
findings.reason: No quip: "a blind spot ... has a name" is the ordinary way to say an effect is named, and the trick "has a rich history" is his.
